summary: Frontend-only UI check on Navbar mobile hamburger menu. Verified in mobile viewport 390x844 that the 'Catégories' 2-column grid is removed and replaced by a single vertical list (data-testid mobile-menu-list) in exact order: Accueil, Boutique, Mode, Tech & Gadgets, Maison, Beauté, Enfants, Cuisine. 'Suivi de commande' pill (data-testid mobile-menu-tracking-link) is pinned at the bottom. Navigation via 'Tech & Gadgets' successfully routes to /boutique/tech. Desktop 1920x800 regression confirms navbar links (Accueil/Boutique/Mode/Tech/Maison/Suivi de colis) still render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx: the hamburger SheetTrigger button lacks a data-testid (e.g. mobile-menu-trigger) which would make future e2e tests more robust — currently tests select via 'header button ... svg' which is brittle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile menu refactor validated end-to-end at 390x844. Note: reopening the Sheet after navigation via the hamburger icon was flaky in Playwright due to Radix overlay pointer-events; consider adding data-testid='mobile-menu-trigger' to the SheetTrigger button. Second flow (reopen menu -> click tracking) was not re-verified after the /boutique/tech nav because of overlay interception, but the tracking link visibility and href were confirmed in the first pass.
